goal: Prevent needed blocks from pruning during wallet downtime or rescans on pruned nodes
Allow users and external services to view and protect block ranges via RPC and startup options
reviewability: Fix pushed for startup prune order awaiting verification
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Useful for internal and external wallets relying on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v)
Approved multiple revisions after thread safety and interface fixes (sedited)
Bug where startup pruning ran before lock registration was addressed (shuv-amp)
